data.title: 英梨梨 · 那须高原私家温泉的水汽微醺
data.description: 在泽村家那须高原的度假别墅内，私人露天风吕水汽蒸腾。英梨梨将标志性的长金发盘在脑后，浸泡在温热的泉水中。当听到屏风后传来的呼唤时，她整个人像熟透的红苹果般沉进水里只露出眼睛，水珠顺着白皙滑腻的肩头滑落，羞愤地娇叱对方不许转过身来。
data.action: 家那须高原的度假别墅内，私人露天风吕水汽蒸腾，英梨梨将标志性的长金发盘在脑后
data.lighting: steamy dusk light with pine trees silhouetted
data.promptProse: In the steaming private outdoor bath of a highland villa at sunset, Eriri pins her hair into a damp bun and sinks down toward the water's surface upon hearing a voice. Warm dusk light catches the steam rising off her flushed face as she glares in embarrassed protest.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude up to her shoulders in the villa's outdoor hot spring with her hair pinned up into a damp bun, she ducks low into the steaming water and glares at the viewer with a flustered crimson blush and tiny fang.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the hot spring with the rippling water rising past her collarbone, droplets glisten across her bare shoulders and damp neck.
